translations.answer: Merge PR #1215 to change broadcaster to `ChainableControllerInterface`, add `offset.force.{x,y,z}` and `offset.torque.{x,y,z}` parameters, apply offset during update, and export corresponding state interfaces; the patch also includes offset and interface value testing. This capability should be used starting from version containing merge commit `4343c7a`. The original post's Humble user has not completed retesting, so do not assume this functionality has been reverted to Humble.
translations.applicability: Applies to versions containing ros2_controllers PR #1215; Hume/backport status must be verified separately.
translations.credibility.rationale: The issue has been closed, environment is clear and there is no conflict, and there is formal documentation or precise independent replication.
translations.details.attempts.0: PR #1215 adds `offset.force.*`/`offset.torque.*` parameters, runtime parameter refresh, `ChainableControllerInterface`, and state-interface export.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Verify that the target ros2_controllers version includes PR #1215 and check if the broadcaster exports six-axis state interfaces.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Use the broadcaster offset parameter in versions containing PR #1215 and connect downstream controller via the exported state interfaces.
translations.details.environments.0: Original post: ROS 2 Humble, Ubuntu 22.04, UR10e, Polyscope 5.11; formal implementation: ros2_controllers master, PR #1215 merge commit `4343c7a`.
translations.details.limits.0: Original author did not retest after merge; the original Humble environment could not build this PR, and no backport conclusion was made.
translations.details.limits.1: Using two broadcasters to form original and offset streams is a project suggestion, but no results were published from the original thread.
translations.details.outcomes.0: PR #1215 has been approved by two reviewers and merged; the patch includes offset values and state interface unit testing.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: How to apply FT sensor offset in real-time within ros2_control and pass the corrected data to the chained controller?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: FT offset should be calibrated under conditions without external force or known load, and monitored for abrupt changes, saturation, and frame_id; offset cannot be used to mask sensor overloads or coordinate system errors.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The old `ForceTorqueSensorBroadcaster` only published the original wrench, without parameterized offset or chained state interfaces.
translations.details.symptoms.0: The existing admittance controller's exponential filter cannot meet the requirement of applying FT offset and simultaneously reading offset/non-offset data streams.
translations.source.locator: ROS 2 Control #1796 project reply; ros2_controllers PR #1215 merge commit `4343c7a4632a97f52fc664b5dcdcad258ffb5e2a`
translations.source.title: ForceTorqueSensorBroadcaster can apply offset and export chained state interface parameters
translations.title: How to apply FT sensor offset in real-time within ros2_control and pass corrected data to the chained controller?
